Run GnRH detection diagnostics

Source: R/diagnostics.R
gnrh_diagnostics.Rd

Generates diagnostic summaries for GnRH detection results, including classification metadata, threshold performance curves, and summary statistics.

Usage

gnrh_diagnostics(object, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object previously processed with detect_gnrh.

verbose

Logical; print progress messages. Default is TRUE.

Value

A Seurat object with diagnostic results stored in object@misc$gnrh.

Details

This function validates required detection outputs generated by detect_gnrh, reconstructs a unified diagnostics table, computes total marker hits, and evaluates classification performance across score thresholds using sensitivity, specificity, precision, and F1 score.

Diagnostic outputs are stored in object@misc$gnrh.

Stored diagnostics include:

diagnostics

Per-cell diagnostic table containing expression, scores, marker hits, and classification labels.

threshold_curve

Threshold performance metrics across the composite score range.

best_threshold

Threshold maximizing F1 score.

Required metadata columns:

  • gnrh_raw

  • gnrh_expr

  • gnrh_score

  • gnrh_class

  • gnrh_core_hits

  • gnrh_mig_hits

  • gnrh_neuro_hits

  • gnrh_confident

If fewer than two confident classes are present, threshold performance metrics are skipped and a warning is issued.

Performance metrics are computed across evenly spaced thresholds:

  • sensitivity

  • specificity

  • precision

  • F1 score

See also

detect_gnrh, run_gnrh
